title: Harbor Lane Outfitters — Information Handling Policy
replies: {"rules":[{"controlId":"AC-01","summary":"Every person signing in to a company system must have an individual named account, and accounts must never be shared between people.","clauseExcerpt":"Each person who signs in to a company system has an individual named account, and an account is never shared between people.","clauseRef":"1. Access control"},{"controlId":"AC-02","summary":"Staff accounts with administrative power require a second sign-in factor in addition to the password.","clauseExcerpt":"Staff accounts with administrative power require a second sign-in factor in addition to the password.","clauseRef":"1. Access control"},{"controlId":"AC-04","summary":"Access held by a departing employee or contractor is removed no later than the end of their final working day.","clauseExcerpt":"Access held by a departing employee or contractor is removed no later than the end of their final working day.","clauseRef":"1. Access control"},{"controlId":"AC-06","summary":"Customer-facing sign-in locks the account for fifteen minutes after five consecutive failed password attempts.","clauseExcerpt":"Customer-facing sign-in locks the account for fifteen minutes after five consecutive failed password attempts.","clauseRef":"1. Access control"},{"controlId":"AC-07","summary":"Sessions in internal tools end automatically after thirty minutes without activity.","clauseExcerpt":"Sessions in internal tools end automatically after thirty minutes without activity.","clauseRef":"1. Access control"}]}

{"rules":[{"controlId":"AL-01","summary":"Record every change to a person's permissions in the audit trail, including who made it, whose permissions changed and when.","clauseExcerpt":"Any change to a person's permissions is recorded in the audit trail with who made the change, whose permissions changed and when.","clauseRef":"2. Audit logging"},{"controlId":"AL-02","summary":"Record every bulk extraction of customer or financial records in the audit trail, naming the person, the time and the scope of what was taken.","clauseExcerpt":"Every bulk extraction of customer or financial records is recorded in the audit trail, naming the person, the time and the scope of what was taken.","clauseRef":"2. Audit logging"},{"controlId":"AL-03","summary":"Protect audit trail entries so that no one, including administrators, can alter or delete them.","clauseExcerpt":"Audit trail entries are protected so that no one, including administrators, can alter or delete them.","clauseRef":"2. Audit logging"},{"controlId":"AL-04","summary":"Security staff must examine audit trail alerts for unusual activity at least once a month.","clauseExcerpt":"Security staff examine audit trail alerts for unusual activity at least once a month.","clauseRef":"2. Audit logging"},{"controlId":"AL-05","summary":"Keep audit trail entries for at least one year.","clauseExcerpt":"Audit trail entries are kept for at least one year.","clauseRef":"2. Audit logging"},{"controlId":"AL-06","summary":"Record staff changes to prices, discounts or payment amounts in the audit trail with the previous value and the new value.","clauseExcerpt":"Changes to prices, discounts or payment amounts made by staff are recorded in the audit trail with the previous value and the new value.","clauseRef":"2. Audit logging"}]}

{"rules":[{"controlId":"DR-01","summary":"Retain financial transaction records for seven years from the end of the relevant fiscal year.","clauseExcerpt":"Financial transaction records are kept for seven years from the end of the fiscal year they belong to.","clauseRef":"3. Data retention"},{"controlId":"DR-02","summary":"Erase or anonymise personal information of closed accounts within ninety days of closure, unless another rule requires retention.","clauseExcerpt":"Personal information about a customer whose account has been closed is erased or anonymised within ninety days of closure, except where another rule requires it to be kept.","clauseRef":"3. Data retention"},{"controlId":"DR-03","summary":"Erase copies of personal information in test or training environments within thirty days.","clauseExcerpt":"Copies of personal information placed in test or training environments are erased within thirty days.","clauseRef":"3. Data retention"},{"controlId":"DR-04","summary":"Keep recorded support calls and chat transcripts for no longer than twelve months.","clauseExcerpt":"Recorded support calls and chat transcripts are kept no longer than twelve months.","clauseRef":"3. Data retention"},{"controlId":"DR-05","summary":"Give every dataset containing personal information a named owner and a documented retention period.","clauseExcerpt":"Every dataset holding personal information has a named owner and a documented retention period.","clauseRef":"3. Data retention"},{"controlId":"DR-06","summary":"Do not destroy records under legal hold until the hold is lifted, regardless of normal retention.","clauseExcerpt":"Records subject to a legal hold are not destroyed until the hold is lifted, whatever their normal retention period.","clauseRef":"3. Data retention"}]}

{"rules":[{"controlId":"EN-01","summary":"Encrypt personal and payment information whenever it is transmitted across a network.","clauseExcerpt":"Personal and payment information is encrypted whenever it travels across a network.","clauseRef":"4. Encryption"},{"controlId":"EN-02","summary":"Encrypt personal and payment information wherever it is stored, including in backups.","clauseExcerpt":"Personal and payment information is encrypted wherever it is stored, including backups.","clauseRef":"4. Encryption"},{"controlId":"EN-03","summary":"Never store full card numbers and keep at most the last four digits for display.","clauseExcerpt":"Full card numbers are never stored; at most the last four digits are kept for display.","clauseRef":"4. Encryption"},{"controlId":"EN-04","summary":"Rotate encryption keys at least once a year and keep them separate from the information they protect.","clauseExcerpt":"Encryption keys are rotated at least once a year and are kept apart from the information they protect.","clauseRef":"4. Encryption"},{"controlId":"EN-05","summary":"Protect files containing personal information sent to outside parties so that only the intended recipient can open them.","clauseExcerpt":"Files containing personal information that are sent to an outside party are protected so that only the intended recipient can open them.","clauseRef":"4. Encryption"}]}

{"rules":[{"controlId":"CM-01","summary":"Every production system change must be approved by someone other than its author before going live.","clauseExcerpt":"Every change to a production system is approved by someone other than the person who made it before it goes live.","clauseRef":"5. Change management"},{"controlId":"CM-02","summary":"Changes must be tested in a non-production environment before release.","clauseExcerpt":"Changes are tested in an environment separate from production before release.","clauseRef":"5. Change management"},{"controlId":"CM-03","summary":"Each production change must have a documented rollback method.","clauseExcerpt":"Each production change has a documented way to undo it.","clauseRef":"5. Change management"},{"controlId":"CM-04","summary":"Emergency changes made without prior approval must be reviewed and approved within two working days afterward.","clauseExcerpt":"Emergency changes made without prior approval are reviewed and approved within two working days afterwards.","clauseRef":"5. Change management"},{"controlId":"CM-05","summary":"Customers must be notified at least five working days before planned downtime of a customer-facing service.","clauseExcerpt":"Customers are told at least five working days in advance of planned downtime of a customer-facing service.","clauseRef":"5. Change management"},{"controlId":"CM-06","summary":"Developers must not have standing permission to change production data directly.","clauseExcerpt":"Developers do not have standing permission to change production data directly.","clauseRef":"5. Change management"}]}

{"rules":[{"controlId":"VM-01","summary":"Require a security review and signed data protection agreement before an outside company receives personal or payment information.","clauseExcerpt":"Before an outside company receives personal or payment information, it completes a security review and signs a data protection agreement.","clauseRef":"6. Vendor management"},{"controlId":"VM-02","summary":"Re-assess outside companies that handle personal information every year.","clauseExcerpt":"Outside companies that handle personal information are re-assessed every year.","clauseRef":"6. Vendor management"},{"controlId":"VM-03","summary":"Give each outside company only the information needed for the service it provides.","clauseExcerpt":"Each outside company is given only the information needed for the service it provides.","clauseRef":"6. Vendor management"},{"controlId":"VM-04","summary":"Require outside companies by contract to report a security incident affecting our information within seventy-two hours.","clauseExcerpt":"Contracts with outside companies require them to report a security incident affecting our information within seventy-two hours.","clauseRef":"6. Vendor management"},{"controlId":"VM-05","summary":"Keep a current register of every outside company handling personal information, including what information each receives.","clauseExcerpt":"A register of every outside company that handles personal information is kept current, including what information each one receives.","clauseRef":"6. Vendor management"}]}

{"rules":[{"controlId":"PR-01","summary":"Collect personal information only for a purpose disclosed to the customer at the point of collection.","clauseExcerpt":"Personal information is collected only for a purpose stated to the customer at the point of collection.","clauseRef":"7. Privacy"},{"controlId":"PR-02","summary":"Send marketing messages only to opted-in customers and include a one-step opt-out in every message.","clauseExcerpt":"Marketing messages are sent only to customers who have opted in, and every message offers a one-step way to opt out.","clauseRef":"7. Privacy"},{"controlId":"PR-03","summary":"Answer a customer's request to see their personal information within thirty days.","clauseExcerpt":"A customer's request to see the personal information held about them is answered within thirty days.","clauseRef":"7. Privacy"},{"controlId":"PR-04","summary":"Collect precise location only with explicit customer permission, which the customer may withdraw at any time.","clauseExcerpt":"Precise location is collected only after the customer gives explicit permission, and that permission can be withdrawn at any time.","clauseRef":"7. Privacy"},{"controlId":"PR-05","summary":"Do not collect personal information of children under sixteen without verified parental or guardian consent.","clauseExcerpt":"Personal information of children under sixteen is not collected without the verified consent of a parent or guardian.","clauseRef":"7.
